name: Qontext
description: Connect Qontext to Claude to give it your company context. Qontext is the self-maintaining context repository for the AI-native company: it keeps company knowledge structured, up to date, permission-aware, and ready to use for every AI agent. Claude can browse the repository, find the right files with exact and hybrid search, read their content, and write updates back. Perfect for answering questions with internal knowledge, drafting documents grounded in your actual processes, or keeping the repository up to date as things change.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Qontext to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Qontext to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.qontext.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Qontext MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Qontext provides these MCP tools: qontext_cat, qontext_find, qontext_grep, qontext_ls, qontext_mkdir, qontext_mv, qontext_rm, qontext_write, and retrieval-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Qontext?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Qontext in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Qontext requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Qontext is developed by Qontext. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
